policy: Curated link-only catalog. Confirm exact upstream source availability, license, version, service terms and data/model rights before adoption. A README-only showcase is not open-source code.

projects.description: Rust GDAL bindings for geodata I/O

projects.description: Streaming geospatial format conversions

projects.name: GeoRust PROJ bindings
projects.description: Rust bindings for PROJ transformations

projects.name: GeoRust RStar
projects.description: R-tree spatial indexing in Rust

projects.name: GeoLibre
projects.description: Open-source GIS web/desktop/mobile platform with Tauri and mapping stack

projects.name: EarthMapper Windows Desktop
projects.description: Windows desktop GIS feature and architecture reference (.NET/WPF, WebView2, MapLibre, analysis, elevation, imagery, GeoAI); GitHub currently contains README only.
projects.license: not-declared; free-for-noncommercial-use is not an open-source license
projects.caveat: Do not assume source code, SDK, binaries or redistribution rights are provided.

projects.name: GeoLibre Plugin Template
projects.description: Plugin scaffolding for GeoLibre; verify current plugin API

projects.name: MapLibre GL JS
projects.description: Open 2D interactive web maps and vector tile rendering

projects.name: CesiumJS
projects.description: Browser-based 2D/3D globe renderer (data services are separate)

projects.name: EarthMapper segmentation
projects.description: Multispectral/hyperspectral imagery classification and semantic segmentation research; legacy environment
projects.caveat: Different historical remote-sensing EarthMapper project, not the Windows desktop GIS or the satellite-map generative study.

projects.name: EarthMapper satellite-map translation
projects.description: Research on bidirectional satellite/map translation; repository currently contains paper README/assets/license without runnable implementation or checkpoints
projects.license: Apache-2.0 (repository files only; model availability unverified)
projects.caveat: The repository contains LICENSE, README and assets but no runnable model implementation or checkpoint. Do not claim the Apache license covers absent weights or external datasets.

projects.name: Awesome GeoRust
projects.description: Third-party curated geospatial Rust ecosystem resources

projects.name: Awesome GIS
projects.description: Third-party curated GIS libraries, tools and software

projects.name: Geo AI Skills
projects.description: Independent geospatial AI agent skills; reference for alternative workflows

projects.name: NetTopologySuite
projects.description: C#/.NET geometry algorithms and topological operations, suitable for desktop spatial editing and analysis.
projects.caveat: Geometry engine only; CRS and metric units must be handled separately.

projects.name: ProjNET
projects.description: Coordinate transformation support for .NET workflows; inspect supported CRS and datum operations for the chosen release.
projects.caveat: Verify the transformation accuracy and available grid shifts for the target region.

projects.name: Microsoft WebView2 Samples
projects.description: Reference code for embedding and communicating with web map/rendering engines in Windows desktop apps.
projects.caveat: WebView2 is an application view bridge, not a GIS renderer or spatial engine.

projects.name: LibTiff.NET
projects.description: C# TIFF image reading/writing useful for raster data formats.
projects.caveat: TIFF encoding alone does not replace GeoTIFF georeferencing/CRS processing or GDAL.

projects.name: netDxf (archived)
projects.description: DXF support used by some desktop GIS workflows; repository is archived.
projects.caveat: Archived upstream: reassess maintenance, security and alternatives before adopting.

projects.name: DuckDB
projects.description: Embedded analytical SQL engine; spatial extension supports location-data workflows where installed and configured.
projects.caveat: Check DuckDB Spatial extension availability, versions, and file-format limitations.

projects.name: ArcGIS Pro SDK for .NET
projects.description: Official documentation and architecture for ArcGIS Pro C#/.NET add-ins, DAML ribbon commands, MVVM and CoreHost.
projects.caveat: ArcGIS Pro version and .NET SDK compatibility are strict; separate from ArcPy.

projects.name: Whitebox Next Gen ArcGIS
projects.description: ArcGIS Pro Python toolbox frontend for Whitebox Next Gen with runtime diagnostics and package integration.
projects.caveat: Some tools/features require specific Whitebox licensing and runtime configuration.

projects.name: PySTAC Client
projects.description: Python STAC API discovery client for satellite imagery catalogs and metadata.
projects.caveat: STAC discovery does not automatically grant hosted imagery access/usage rights.

projects.name: TiTiler
projects.description: Python dynamic tiling server for raster and cloud-optimized GeoTIFF data.
projects.caveat: Operating a tile service has caching, server, security and data-service cost implications.

projects.name: Leafmap
projects.description: Interactive geospatial visualization and analysis from Python and notebooks.
projects.caveat: Some basemap services and notebooks rely on external provider access.

projects.name: GeoAI Python
projects.description: Geospatial machine-learning workflows, remote-sensing inference and related QGIS plugin integration.
projects.caveat: Model weights, datasets and framework dependencies retain separate licenses.

projects.name: GeoPandas
projects.description: Python GeoDataFrame processing built on pandas/Shapely/PyProj and file IO.
projects.caveat: Use projected coordinates/geodesic operations for physical distances and areas.

projects.name: PyProj
projects.description: Python interface to PROJ for CRS transformations and geodesic calculations.
projects.caveat: Check axis order, datum grids and CRS units in explicit tests.

projects.name: ONNX Runtime
projects.description: Cross-platform inference runtime for compatible ML/ONNX models in desktop and GIS applications.
projects.caveat: Neural networks are not automatically geospatially aware: preserve pixel-to-world transforms.

projects.name: Segment Anything 2
projects.description: Open vision-segmentation research model and tools for imagery; requires GIS-aware postprocessing for usable map layers.
projects.caveat: Check pretrained-weight licenses, data handling, GPU requirements, and georeferencing of results.

projects.name: GeoLibre R
projects.description: MIT-licensed R htmlwidgets package embedding GeoLibre in RStudio, Quarto, R Markdown and Shiny with geospatial layers, project files and interactive controls.
projects.caveat: Hosted GeoLibre deployment and remote raster/map services retain independent availability, access and terms. COG requires CORS/range support.

projects.name: RustGIS by opengeos
projects.description: Apache-2.0 Rust GIS workspace with raster/vector functionality, ribbon UI, command/CLI architecture, WASM targets, plugins and Python interface.
projects.caveat: Do not confuse this application with the independent GeoRust libraries ecosystem. Benchmark and test releases and underlying online services before adopting.
